# Spark compatibility

Status per surface. Anything not listed here is unknown and not supported.

## File formats

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Parquet | supported |  |
| CSV | supported |  |
| JSON | supported |  |
| Text | supported |  |
| Avro | supported |  |
| ORC | not yet |  |
| Writing ORC (`df.write.orc`, `format("orc").save`) | not yet | Fails with KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE; `df.write.orc` does not exist. |

## Object stores

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Amazon S3 and S3-compatible stores | supported |  |
| Google Cloud Storage | supported |  |
| Azure Blob Storage and ADLS Gen2 | supported |  |

## SQL

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Queries (SELECT, joins, aggregates, window functions, set operations, CTEs) | partial | Measured by the Spark golden suite below. |
| Subqueries (scalar, IN, EXISTS, correlated) | partial | Common shapes are supported; remaining gaps appear as failures in the golden suite. |
| DDL and DML (CREATE/INSERT/DELETE on file-backed tables and views) | partial | Statements the golden suite covers are counted in its pass rates. |
| `bucketBy` on writes | not yet | Fails with a clear unsupported-feature error. |
| DataFrameWriterV2 (`writeTo`) | partial | `create` and `append` work in a Python session. `createOrReplace` and `replace` fail as REPLACE TABLE AS SELECT does; `overwrite(condition)` and `overwritePartitions` always fail with KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE; `partitionedBy` and `clusterBy` fail when the write runs. Spark Connect clients cannot use `writeTo` yet. |
| Spark version | partial | Krishiv 0.3 runs as Spark 4.3 by default (the Spark 4.2 profile is selectable); Spark 3.5, 4.0 and 4.1 behaviour is not selectable yet. |

## Spark Connect

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spark Connect server (subset) | not yet |  |

## User-defined functions

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rust UDFs | supported |  |
| Python `@udf` and scalar `pandas_udf` / `arrow_udf` | supported |  |
| Grouped-aggregate `pandas_udf`, `applyInPandas`, `mapInPandas`, `cogroup` | supported | Embedded relation UDFs run on the Python pool, one pool thread per task (`krishiv.python.udf.threads`). `barrier=True` is refused. Grouped-aggregate UDFs over a window (`.over(window)`) are refused. |
| Scalar-iterator `pandas_udf` / `arrow_udf` | not yet | Refused as NOT_IMPLEMENTED when embedded. |

## Not covered

| Surface | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RDD API, `SparkContext`, `SparkConf` and broadcast variables | not yet | The Python package has no `sparkContext`, `rdd` or `SparkConf`; use DataFrames and SQL. |
| `pyspark.pandas` (pandas API on Spark) | not yet | Not provided. `toPandas()` and scalar `pandas_udf` work. |
| `pyspark.ml` and MLlib | not yet | Not provided. |
| `spark-submit` and cluster managers (`master('yarn')`, `spark.executor.*` keys) | not yet | Not provided; a script runs in-process. |
| Spark Streaming and Structured Streaming APIs in Python | not yet | Not available in 0.3. |
| XML file source (`format('xml')`) | not yet | Fails with DATA_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: xml. |
| JDBC data source and Hive support | not yet | Not provided. |

## Spark golden suite

Measured against Apache Spark v4.3.0's own SQL test files (20779 statements in 366 files).

| Check | Passed | Total | Rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Parse | 19758 | 20308 | 97.2% |
| Error class of negative cases | 3752 | 4049 | 92.6% |
| Result rows | 15035 | 16686 | 90.1% |
